metadataRaw.title: How to Decompress Your Back In 30 SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your back in as little as 30 seconds. 

Think of a deep pulling motion, known as traction, that quickly takes pressure off muscles, joints, and spinal discs.

These are great for helping with everything from minor aches to severe conditions such as herniated discs, bulging discs, and pinched nerves that cause sciatica pain. 

All of the exercises work a little differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief. 

As a bonus, the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give back pain and sciatica relief within 30 seconds.

Let us know which one worked best for you!
